# Siemens Mobility Toolkit / BenQ Mobile Toolkit

**Author:** Siemens Mobile, BenQ Mobile

<img
  className="screenshot"
  src={require("./mobility-toolkit/img/mobility-toolkit.png").default}
  alt={"Siemens Mobility Toolkit / BenQ Mobile Toolkit: screenshot 1"}
/>

Environments for running individual emulator packages for Siemens and
BenQ-Siemens phones. Siemens emulators use Siemens Mobility Toolkit
2.10.02, while BenQ Mobile emulators use BenQ Mobile Toolkit 3.2.626.

## Versions

- **3.2.626** — [mobility-toolkit-3.2.626.zip](https://git.siepatch.dev/siepatch/soft/media/branch/main/catalog/emulators/mobility-toolkit/files/mobility-toolkit-3.2.626.zip)<br/>BenQ Mobile Toolkit<br/>Windows 32-bit · 45.5 MiB
